title: [IMP-03] Set up PPAP scope and the integrated part warrant
description:
Source task
PPAP implementation plan / IMP-03

Source plan
docs/phase 2/ppap/solution_specification/implementation-plan.json; plan date 2026-11-17; SHA-256 16059e862dd86c29ccbe374cabe8c001bbdab4667e74f46dadf2122b8f479d54

Task ID
IMP-03

Title
Set up PPAP scope and the integrated part warrant

Category
Fields and forms

Objective
Let the SIA PPAP Engineer prepare the exact facility, drawing and part scope that a supplier will confirm.

Detailed scope
Add the target PPAP scope fields, selected-part and shipping-depot controls, and ordinary Draft form behavior. Change the two verified legacy display/due-date settings while retaining existing identity, owner, settings and originating links. Keep authoritative criticality read only and make the two part masses available for supplier entry at the permitted stage.

Deliverable
A scoped PPAP setup form and part-warrant fields with clear internal/supplier responsibilities.

Work needed first
IMP-01 — Create the PPAP Objects and workflow stages
IMP-02 — Set up PPAP reference lists and operating settings
IMP-09 — Set up PPAP templates and their requirement matrix
IMP-12 — Set up engineering source and drawing-review forms

What the earlier tasks provide
• IMP-01 provides the new Objects, native stage/termination identities and target-record marker.
• IMP-02 provides the seven governed lists and operating-policy fields/default entries.
• IMP-09 provides the template/matrix authoring and version fields/forms.
• IMP-12 provides the engineering-release/source-part/review fields and preparation forms.

What is waiting
Partly waiting: the ordinary scalar, part-mass and local-record controls can proceed; external selectors and the replacement legacy expressions wait for the named bindings.

Recommended implementer role
Senior Associate Consultant

Recommended reviewer/approver role
Senior Consultant — PPAP build reviewer (a different person)

Why this role is recommended
The assignment combines established field, related-list and form settings. A Senior Associate Consultant can apply the conditions consistently, with the separate build reviewer checking their effect on the wider process.

Fields and features to set up
PPAP.Type
Create a link to PPAP Type, selecting exactly one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Keep its inverse disabled. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Responsible SIA PPAP Engineer in Draft; read only after Issue; new selection filters Active?=TRUE; preserve existing inactive references read only. Field/control lifecycle: Draft Save validates; fixed at Issue.

PPAP.Manufacturing Facility
Create a link to Supplier Facility, selecting zero or one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Keep its inverse disabled. Required only in the conditions stated below; otherwise optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: SIA PPAP Engineer selects current eligible manufacturing facility in Draft; supplier read only; mandatory before Issue. Field/control lifecycle: Issue freezes scope; never use inherited Location or Supplier as this relationship.

PPAP.Drawing Revision
Create a link to Operational Drawing Revision, selecting zero or one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Keep its inverse disabled. Required only in the conditions stated below; otherwise optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: System maps accepted operational source; SIA PPAP Engineer selects validated source in Draft; mandatory before Issue. Field/control lifecycle: Issue freezes released engineering context; a different engineering change creates a NEW PPAP.

PPAP.Engineering Release
Create a link to PPAP Engineering Release, selecting zero or one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Enable the reverse read-only list PPAP Engineering Release.PPAPs. Required only in the conditions stated below; otherwise optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: SIA PPAP Engineer selects accepted authoritative drawing/part context in Draft; mandatory before Issue for ALL origins including PCR/manual. Field/control lifecycle: PCR/manual may reference the existing accepted released drawing context without a new ECS event; controlled intake captures it if absent. Create initializes source; Issue snapshots classifications; no in-flight absorption.

PPAP.Drawing Number
Set the type to Text; up to 100 characters. Required only in the conditions stated below; otherwise optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: PPAP Engineering Release.Drawing Number at source selection. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly; must be populated before Issue. Field/control lifecycle: Controlled manual fallback imports authoritative source; issue locks number, no PPAP override.

PPAP.Drawing Revision Code
Set the type to Text; up to 100 characters. Required only in the conditions stated below; otherwise optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: PPAP Engineering Release.Drawing Revision Code at source selection. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly; mandatory before Issue. Field/control lifecycle: Issue freezes original revision; later change creates new PPAP.

PPAP.Drawing Review
Create a link to PPAP Drawing Review, selecting zero or one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Enable the reverse read-only list PPAP Drawing Review.PPAPs. Optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: System set by Launch PPAP; read only. Field/control lifecycle: Retain initial review provenance.

PPAP.Originating PCR
Create a link to MOC PCR, selecting zero or one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Keep its inverse disabled. Optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: System set by authorized Proceed to PPAP adapter; internal read only. Field/control lifecycle: Idempotent launch per PCR decision token and approved scope; no shipment authorization.

PPAP.Replaces PPAP
Create a link to PPAP, selecting zero or one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Keep its inverse disabled. Optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: SIA PPAP Engineer selects relevant cancelled PPAP in Draft; read only after Issue. Field/control lifecycle: Informational lineage only; does not bypass cancelled-source evidence exclusion.

PPAP.Service Parts Only?
Set the type to Yes/No (Boolean). Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: FALSE. Who can use it and when: SIA PPAP Engineer in Draft; mandatory validation against approved part purpose before Issue. Field/control lifecycle: Eligibility adapter queries central supplier status capabilities; service flag is purpose, not a supplier-status override.

PPAP.Visibility Classification
Create a link to Shared Record Visibility Classification, selecting exactly one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Keep its inverse disabled. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Designated visibility manager only; supplier read only. Field/control lifecycle: Controlled audited ADR-084 handover may change access without changing criticality, workflow or ownership.

PPAP.Template
Create a link to PPAP Template, selecting zero or one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Keep its inverse disabled. Required only in the conditions stated below; otherwise optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: SIA PPAP Engineer in Draft; active published template matching Type; mandatory before Issue. Field/control lifecycle: Select Template action resolves exact active published version; cannot switch while generated elements remain.

PPAP.Template Version
Create a link to PPAP Template Version, selecting zero or one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Keep its inverse disabled. Required only in the conditions stated below; otherwise optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly; mandatory before Issue. Field/control lifecycle: Initialize Elements resolves exact active version under lock, stores and never refreshes on later publication.

PPAP.Operating Policy
Create a link to PPAP Operating Policy, selecting exactly one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Keep its inverse disabled. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly. Field/control lifecycle: Create handler binds single active operating policy; current configurable settings govern future reminders; issued deadline snapshots remain fixed.

PPAP.Engineer Routing Entity
Create a link to Supplier Abstract, selecting zero or one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Keep its inverse disabled. Required only in the conditions stated below; otherwise optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: SIA PPAP Engineer or administrator in Draft; required before Issue; exact governed supplier context. Field/control lifecycle: Resolve internal supplier-specific SIA PPAP Engineer role by Type and Operating Policy role mapping; no company-to-facility/depot fallback; issued routing context retained.

PPAP.Engineer Role
Create a link to Supplier Specific Role, selecting zero or one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Keep its inverse disabled. Required only in the conditions stated below; otherwise optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly; required before Issue. Field/control lifecycle: Resolve Engineer Routing Entity plus current policy role for Type; Project Owner must be current eligible member at Issue and on SIA PPAP Engineer action; reassignment stays in eligible role.

PPAP Part.PPAP
Create a link to PPAP, selecting exactly one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Enable the reverse read-only list PPAP.Parts. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly; creation action binds exact owning record; no later reassignment. Field/control lifecycle: Create Action Handler binds relationship in the authorized creation context; never user-reassign; preserve related-record history.

PPAP Part.Part
Create a link to Operational Part, selecting exactly one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Keep its inverse disabled. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: SIA PPAP Engineer selects active drawing-associated part in Draft. Field/control lifecycle: Validate exact drawing association and facility eligibility; no free-text part identity.

PPAP Part.Source Release Part
Create a link to PPAP Engineering Release Part, selecting zero or one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Keep its inverse disabled. Required only in the conditions stated below; otherwise optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly; mandatory before Issue for ALL origins. Field/control lifecycle: Selection handler requires Part equal selected Part, Engineering Release equal PPAP.Engineering Release and its Drawing Revision equal PPAP.Drawing Revision; copies authoritative flags and identity; missing/mismatched provenance blocks Issue.

PPAP Part.Part Number
Set the type to Text; up to 100 characters. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: Source Release Part.Part Number. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly. Field/control lifecycle: Select Part copies display identity; frozen at Issue.

PPAP Part.Part Description
Set the type to Text; up to 255 characters. Optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: Source Release Part.Part Description. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly. Field/control lifecycle: Select Part captures description for approved certificate and historical scope.

PPAP Part.Important Safety?
Set the type to Yes/No (Boolean). Required only in the conditions stated below; otherwise optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL until authoritative source known. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly; all three must be non-NULL before Issue. Field/control lifecycle: Select Part copies Source Release Part.Important Safety?; no PPAP override; Issue freezes; applicable correction requires cancel/replace.

PPAP Part.Important Quality?
Set the type to Yes/No (Boolean). Required only in the conditions stated below; otherwise optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL until authoritative source known. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly; all three must be non-NULL before Issue. Field/control lifecycle: Select Part copies Source Release Part.Important Quality?; no PPAP override; Issue freezes; applicable correction requires cancel/replace.

PPAP Part.Regulated?
Set the type to Yes/No (Boolean). Required only in the conditions stated below; otherwise optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL until authoritative source known. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly; all three must be non-NULL before Issue. Field/control lifecycle: Select Part copies Source Release Part.Regulated?; no PPAP override; Issue freezes; applicable correction requires cancel/replace.

PPAP Part.Average Actual Mass (kg)
Set the type to a finite number allowing decimals (Float); display up to 6 decimal places; no silent rounding of stored values. Required only in the conditions stated below; otherwise optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Authorized supplier may edit before final submission; internal SIA PPAP Engineer read only. Field/control lifecycle: Required for every included part before Complete PPAP; >0; freeze at final submission, reopen for non-scope correction on management return only.

PPAP Part.Average Metal Mass (kg)
Set the type to a finite number allowing decimals (Float); display up to 6 decimal places; no silent rounding of stored values. Required only in the conditions stated below; otherwise optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Authorized supplier may edit before final submission; internal SIA PPAP Engineer read only. Field/control lifecycle: Required for every included part before Complete PPAP; 0 <= value <= Average Actual Mass (kg); 0 confirms no metal; NULL remains unknown; freeze at final submission; coordinated correction of both mass fields on management return uses supplier-safe feedback, audit and refreezes on resubmission.

PPAP Shipping Depot.PPAP
Create a link to PPAP, selecting exactly one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Enable the reverse read-only list PPAP.Shipping Depots. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly; creation action binds exact owning record; no later reassignment. Field/control lifecycle: Create Action Handler binds relationship in the authorized creation context; never user-reassign; preserve related-record history.

PPAP Shipping Depot.Shipping Depot
Create a link to Supplier Facility, selecting exactly one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Keep its inverse disabled. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: SIA PPAP Engineer selects eligible shipping depot for Manufacturing Facility context while open; audited; no scope expansion. Field/control lifecycle: Validate governed depot semantics and entity access; unique PPAP+Shipping Depot; does not change approved manufacturing scope.

PPAP.Parts
Create a read-only related-record list over PPAP Part.PPAP; one owning record can show many linked entries (inverse 1:M). Store no second link. Optional navigation only. Apply the owning-record and file permissions; make the list read only and populate it only through the declaring link, with no separate stored value.

PPAP.Shipping Depots
Create a read-only related-record list over PPAP Shipping Depot.PPAP; one owning record can show many linked entries (inverse 1:M). Store no second link. Optional navigation only. Apply the owning-record and file permissions; make the list read only and populate it only through the declaring link, with no separate stored value.

PPAP Engineering Release.PPAPs
Create a read-only related-record list over PPAP.Engineering Release; one owning record can show many linked entries (inverse 1:M). Store no second link. Optional navigation only. Apply the owning-record and file permissions; make the list read only and populate it only through the declaring link, with no separate stored value.

PPAP Drawing Review.PPAPs
Create a read-only related-record list over PPAP.Drawing Review; one owning record can show many linked entries (inverse 1:M). Store no second link. Optional navigation only. Apply the owning-record and file permissions; make the list read only and populate it only through the declaring link, with no separate stored value.

Changes to the existing setup
PPAP Due Date / SubmissionDate (928f4637-0e14-46dc-89bc-90cb6e3fadd2; APQP & PPAP Manager package /GraphData/Items/249)
The package defaults to Task.Workflow.DueDate. Keep its required Date type and timezone setting. For target records remove that unconditional default: require the SIA PPAP Engineer to supply the date at Draft creation, or let the authorized APQP launch copy a valid linked Task due date once. Historical records retain the original branch.

PPAP DisplayField (998bd167-41b8-46bf-bc08-b1baa5ec3a50; /GraphData/Items/579)
The package uses CONCATENATE("PPAP ",Product," - ",Product.Name) and exports no maximum. For target records set maximum 512 characters and a continuing display calculation from inherited RecordNo, Drawing Number and Drawing Revision Code in that order, separated by " / "; omit empty context components and never silently truncate identity. Keep the historical Product-based branch; supported executable syntax is a supplied input.

Build instructions
1. Arrange the internal Draft controls around Manufacturing Facility, Drawing Revision/Engineering Release, Type, selected Parts, Shipping Depots, Template and responsibility. Label the existing Project Owner control SIA PPAP Engineer in the target view; it remains the same existing field and always represents an internal user.
2. Limit selected parts to the authoritative drawing/revision and release. Require Source Release Part.Part to equal the selected Part, its release to equal PPAP.Engineering Release and that release Drawing Revision to equal the PPAP Drawing Revision. Copy Part Number, Part Description and all three criticality values; never provide PPAP criticality overrides.
3. Keep manufacturing facility, drawing/revision, selected parts and authoritative flags read only after issue. Keep a depot separate from approved manufacturing scope; adding contextual depot routing does not grant facility access.
4. Show both mass controls to authorized supplier users while PPAP is In Progress. Require each actual mass >0 and metal mass >=0 and <= actual mass before final submission, with kilograms displayed; NULL is unknown, metal 0 means confirmed no metal. Hide internal management content. Finalization owns the final server-side completeness check.

How to check the result
• A selected source part from another part, release or drawing revision is rejected instead of supplying its flags to the PPAP.
• A target Draft can use a supplied overall date with no Task link; its label no longer depends on singular Product.
• Actual mass 1.2 and metal mass 0 are valid; metal 1.3 against actual 1.2 is rejected; missing mass is not converted to zero.

Information needed for this task
IN-02: Supply native operational Drawing Revision/Part identifiers and authoritative source/facility/depot mapping for the reference controls; known scalar and mass controls can proceed.
IN-06: Supply the visibility record selection and supplier actor/access connection used by these controls; no supplier may receive draft access.
IN-14: Supply the supported target-only display/default expression method; the required business calculation and maximum are specified in this assignment.
IN-05: Supply the exact shared Engineer Routing Entity/Engineer Role reference bindings and eligible internal role identifiers for those selectors; ordinary scalar and mass controls remain ready.
IN-08: Supply the actual MOC PCR record/field binding for PPAP.Originating PCR. This blocks only that external selector; launch/outcome behavior belongs to the originating connection assignment.

Supplied input context
• IN-02 — Operational engineering data and record links: SIA and the operational Product Management owner must supply the separate BOMEX/ECS delivery contract, producer/event/revision keys, drawing and part object/field identifiers, facility/depot crosswalks, explicit classification authority/precedence, full/delta/correction/removal rules, source ordering, accepted release criteria and external endpoint/credentials. Source selectors, receipt and correction processing wait for these exact values; the isolated Product Integration application is not that connection.
• IN-06 — Record visibility, file access and supplier actor connection: The security/technical team must supply visibility classification values and access rules, native record/file/API/export enforcement methods, authorized handover principals, and the supported external-supplier-user to native actor/recipient identity connection. This information limits the affected security, posting, confirmation and recorded-actor settings.
• IN-14 — Target screens and supported expressions: The technical team must supply supported expressions and view-action methods where this design states business logic rather than executable Intelex syntax, together with the effective tenant view/module identifiers if they differ from the package. Build assignments use the verified package names and must not guess a replacement expression or tenant target.
• IN-05 — Approved SIA roles, supplier roles and capability rules: The SRM/security owners must supply the governed library-role and exact-entity role identifiers, populated memberships, SIA engineer selections, inspection teams/leaders, management approver pool and PPAP administrator group. They must also supply central ACTIVE/SERVICE/INACTIVE capability identifiers and reconcile the annotated central open-work transition rule. These are existing shared authorities; membership administration and central policy decisions are outside the build assignments.
• IN-08 — PCR and APQP launch and outcome connections: The PCR/APQP owners must supply the Proceed to PPAP decision token and fields, authorized launch/callback actions, originating owner-resolution destination, and the rule for obligations served by multiple linked PPAPs. Target launch and successful/cancelled outcomes wait for those connections; no new MOC/PCR lifecycle is assigned.

Specification references

Assumptions and open questions
New operational PPAPs only. SIA PPAP Engineer means an internal SIA user; supplier personnel act through their separate supplier roles.
